paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: Analysis plot of the number of tweets corresponding to the number of sentiments.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “Analysis plot of the number of tweets corresponding to the number of sentiments,” illustrates the distribution of tweets based on the number of sentiment labels assigned to them, as part of an analysis of vaccine-related sentiments. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of labels,” displays discrete integer categories from 0 to 5, representing the count of sentiment labels associated with each tweet. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of tweets,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to over 400,000, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 100,000. The chart contains five bars, each corresponding to one category on the x-axis: a very short blue bar for 0 labels (approximately 10,000 tweets), a tall brown bar for 1 label (approximately 450,000 tweets), a tall green bar for 2 labels (approximately 410,000 tweets), a medium red bar for 3 labels (approximately 90,000 tweets), and a very short purple bar for 4 labels (approximately 10,000 tweets). There is no bar for 5 labels. The bars are presented in a single group, not stacked or grouped, and are arranged in ascending order of their x-axis values, with no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
